description:
List every gnomAD variant in a gene, transcript, or region with allele frequencies, filtering allele frequencies, zygosity counts, predicted consequences with LOFTEE's loss-of-function call, and QC status, optionally filtered to one consequence class (lof, missense, synonymous, other), a LOFTEE confidence (lof_confidence HC or LC), a maximum allele frequency, and/or a maximum filtering allele frequency (faf95_max, the value to test against a disease threshold such as ACMG/AMP BA1 or BS1). Pass annotations: true to add each row's HGVS c. and p. notation, LOFTEE filter and flags, and rsIDs. Every row carries its exome and genome QC filters and a qc_status; qc_filtered counts the matching variants that failed QC in every callset carrying them (often AC0, no high-quality carrier, at AF 0), which gnomAD's browser hides by default — read them as low-confidence, not observed variants, or pass pass_only to drop them. Each call returns one page: up to limit matching variants from offset, in gnomAD's genomic order, with total counting every match; pass next_offset as offset until it is null. gnomAD lists a target only whole, so each page re-fetches the whole target — page a large gene with filters and a large limit. At offset 0, a result too large to inline is also staged on a DataCanvas table named gene_variants holding every matching variant, returned as canvas_id and table_name — call gnomad_dataframe_describe for its columns, then gnomad_dataframe_query to rank by AF, count by consequence, or group across every row rather than one page. A result that fits inline stages no table unless canvas_id is supplied, and a page past offset 0 never stages. Supply exactly one of gene, transcript_id, or region. Echoes the resolved target, the row filters, and the effective dataset and build.
Data source: gnomAD (Broad Institute) — https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/

annotations.description: Add five columns describing each row's transcript_id after every default column, on the rows and in the staged gene_variants table: hgvsc, hgvsp, lof_filter, lof_flags, and rsids (pipe-joined). Omitted or false, the rows and the table carry none of them. A column toggle, not a filter: it keeps every row and filters does not echo it. It widens every row by about a quarter and every page's re-fetch of the target from gnomAD by about as much.

canvas_id.description: Optional canvas ID from a prior call, to reuse the same canvas. When supplied, a call at offset 0 always writes its result to the gene_variants table on that canvas, replacing (not appending to) the previous one, its columns included: the table takes this call's annotations shape — even when the result fits inline; a result with no variants removes the table. A page past offset 0 leaves the table as it was. Omit to stage on a fresh canvas only when the result is too large to inline.

consequence_class.description: Keep only variants in this gnomAD consequence category, read from each row's consequence: lof (pLoF) is transcript_ablation, splice_acceptor_variant, splice_donor_variant, stop_gained, frameshift_variant; missense (missense / inframe indel) is missense_variant, stop_lost, start_lost, inframe_insertion, inframe_deletion; synonymous is synonymous_variant; other is every other term and a null consequence. Omit to return all classes.

dataset.description: gnomAD dataset, default gnomad_r4: gnomad_r4 and its subset gnomad_r4_non_ukb (GRCh38); gnomad_r3 and its subsets gnomad_r3_controls_and_biobanks, gnomad_r3_non_cancer, gnomad_r3_non_neuro, gnomad_r3_non_topmed, gnomad_r3_non_v2 (GRCh38); gnomad_r2_1 and its subsets gnomad_r2_1_controls, gnomad_r2_1_non_cancer, gnomad_r2_1_non_neuro, gnomad_r2_1_non_topmed (GRCh37); exac (GRCh37). A subset keeps only part of its parent release's samples (non_cancer leaves out cancer-study samples, non_ukb UK Biobank's) and can leave a callset unchanged: gnomad_r4_non_ukb genome counts equal gnomad_r4's, and gnomad_r2_1_non_cancer genome counts equal gnomad_r2_1's. No subset publishes joint data, and gnomAD publishes no subset coverage or constraint, so those come from the parent. Echoed in output.

anyOf.description: Gene — HGNC symbol (e.g. PCSK9) or Ensembl gene ID (e.g. ENSG00000169174). Obtain a stable ID from ensembl_lookup_gene.
Blank — the gene is treated as omitted.

gene.description: Gene — HGNC symbol (e.g. PCSK9) or Ensembl gene ID (e.g. ENSG00000169174). Obtain a stable ID from ensembl_lookup_gene. Mitochondrial genes (e.g. MT-TL1) are not served. Mutually exclusive with transcript_id and region; blank means omitted.

limit.description: Matching variants on this page. Default 25; a value above 3,000 is clamped to 3,000, with a notice.

lof_confidence.description: Keep only variants whose lof — LOFTEE's call on the row's transcript_id — equals this: HC high-confidence or LC low-confidence. A row with lof null or OS matches neither. consequence_class lof reads the consequence term instead, so it keeps LoF terms LOFTEE did not call. Omit to keep every call.

max_af.description: Keep only variants with allele frequency ≤ this value (0–1). Variants with null AF are always kept.

max_faf.description: Keep only variants whose filtering allele frequency (faf95_max) is ≤ this value (0–1) — the test against a disease threshold such as ACMG/AMP BA1 or BS1. Variants with a null faf95_max are always kept, and a notice counts them among total. gnomad_r3, its subsets, and exac list rows carry no FAF, so there it filters nothing and the notice says so.

offset.description: Zero-based position, among the variants the filters keep, of the first one on this page. Pass next_offset from the previous call to continue.

pass_only.description: Keep only variants that passed gnomAD QC in at least one callset carrying them (qc_status pass), with the counts gnomAD's browser table shows by default: a row without joint data (every dataset but gnomad_r4, gnomad_r4_non_ukb included) reads ac, an, af, homozygote_count, hemizygote_count, and faf95_max from its passing callsets only, and max_af and max_faf filter on those values; gnomad_r4 rows keep their joint counts. The drop follows consequence_class, lof_confidence, max_af, and max_faf, and qc_filtered still counts the dropped rows. Omit to list every matching variant with its QC columns and a QC-failed callset's counts included — a single-position region then never reads as absent because of QC.

reference_genome.description: Reference build. Derived from dataset when omitted: GRCh38 for gnomad_r4, gnomad_r3, and their subsets; GRCh37 for gnomad_r2_1, its subsets, and exac. If supplied it must match the dataset, or the call is rejected. Keep aligned with ensembl coordinates.

anyOf.description: Genomic region chrom-start-stop (1-based inclusive, e.g. 1-55039447-55064852) on chromosome 1–22, X, or Y, optional chr prefix.

region.description: Genomic region chrom-start-stop (1-based inclusive, e.g. 1-55039447-55064852): chromosome 1–22, X, or Y with an optional chr prefix (mitochondrial regions are not served), a span (stop − start) under 2,500,000 bp, and at most ~30,000 variants. Mutually exclusive with gene and transcript_id.

transcript_id.description: Ensembl transcript ID (e.g. ENST00000302118). Mutually exclusive with gene and region; blank means omitted.

name: gnomad_list_gene_variants

canvas_id.description: Canvas holding table_name (or the canvas_id you supplied) — pass it to gnomad_dataframe_describe, then gnomad_dataframe_query. Empty when this call used no canvas: the result fit inline and no canvas_id was supplied, or the page started past offset 0.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_target`: Not exactly one of gene, transcript_id, or region was supplied. `incoherent_build`: reference_genome was supplied but does not match the dataset. `invalid_region`: The region names a chromosome outside 1–22, X, Y, or breaks the coordinate bounds. `region_too_large`: The region spans 2,500,000 bp or more, or holds more variants (~30,000) than gnomAD lists at once. `mitochondrial_unsupported`: The gene, transcript, or region is on the mitochondrial chromosome (M or MT). `gene_not_found`: gnomAD holds no gene matching the symbol or Ensembl ID in this build. `transcript_not_found`: gnomAD holds no transcript matching transcript_id in this build. `graphql_error`: gnomAD rejected the variant-list query with a GraphQL error. `upstream_unavailable`: gnomAD stayed unavailable or throttled through every retry. `upstream_timeout`: gnomAD attempts timed out or the shared 45 s call budget expired. `upstream_access`: gnomAD refused the request (access denied). `invalid_upstream_response`: gnomAD kept answering with a response that failed validation. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filters.description: The row filters this call applied, each null when not set. offset, limit, canvas_id, and annotations are not filters.

anyOf.description: gnomAD's category of consequence (the terms each holds are listed on the consequence_class filter): lof is pLoF, missense covers missense and inframe indels, start_lost, and stop_lost; other includes a null consequence.

consequence_class.description: The consequence_class filter; null when omitted.

lof_confidence.description: The lof_confidence filter; null when omitted.

max_af.description: The max_af filter; null when omitted.

max_faf.description: The max_faf filter; null when omitted.

pass_only.description: true when pass_only was set; null when omitted or false.

next_offset.description: offset for the next page; null when this page reaches the last matching variant.

notice.description: Guidance when no variants matched, when matching variants failed gnomAD QC (the qc_filtered count, and what pass_only dropped), when max_faf is set (how many variants in total it kept untested for a null faf95_max, or that the dataset carries no FAF on its rows), when limit was clamped to its cap, the next offset when no staged table holds the rest, an offset past the end, and — when a table was staged — its name with the next steps: gnomad_dataframe_describe, then gnomad_dataframe_query.

preview.description: This page: up to limit matching variants from offset, in genomic order — the immediate answer.

items.description: One gene-variant row — also the canvas table column set: the default columns, then, with annotations, hgvsc, hgvsp, lof_filter, lof_flags, and rsids.

ac.description: Allele count — gnomAD's joint exome + genome count on gnomad_r4; on every other dataset, gnomad_r4_non_ukb and the other subsets included (no joint data), the sum across carried callsets, or under pass_only across those that passed QC.

af.description: Allele frequency, ac/an from the same source — the value max_af filters on, so under pass_only a row without joint data reads its passing callsets; null when an is 0.

an.description: Allele number. On gnomad_r4, gnomAD's joint AN over every callable sample in both callsets, including a callset that does not carry the variant or failed QC; on every other dataset (no joint data — gnomad_r4_non_ukb and every other subset, gnomad_r3, gnomad_r2_1, exac), the sum across carried callsets — a QC-failed one included, except under pass_only, which sums only the callsets that passed, as gnomAD's browser table does.

consequence.description: VEP consequence term, as gnomAD's tables show it: the most severe in the gene on a gene target, the named transcript's term on a transcript target, the most severe across transcripts on a region target. It can sit on a non-primary isoform — see consequence_transcript. Null when none.

consequence_class.description: gnomAD's category of consequence (the terms each holds are listed on the consequence_class filter): lof is pLoF, missense covers missense and inframe indels, start_lost, and stop_lost; other includes a null consequence.

consequence_transcript.description: On a gene target, where transcript_id sits as gnomAD's gene table marks it (†): mane_select when it is the gene's MANE Select transcript; canonical when the gene has no MANE Select (none on any GRCh37 dataset: gnomad_r2_1, its subsets, and exac) and it is the canonical transcript; other when the consequence is on another transcript, so it may be milder or absent on the primary one — gnomad_get_variant's primary_transcript gives that term. Null on transcript and region targets, and for a gene with neither a MANE Select nor a canonical transcript.

exome_filters.description: QC filters gnomAD applied to the exome call, pipe-joined (e.g. AC0|AS_VQSR; the set varies by dataset, RF on gnomad_r2_1). Empty when the exome call passed QC; null when the exome callset does not carry the variant or gnomAD returned no filter list.

faf95_max.description: gnomAD's filtering allele frequency (GroupMax FAF95): the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval of a genetic-ancestry group's AF, from the group with the highest bound, over non-bottlenecked groups — the value max_faf filters on and the one to test against a disease threshold such as ACMG/AMP BA1 or BS1, which raw AF is not. From the same records as ac and an: gnomAD's joint value on gnomad_r4 (the same figure as gnomad_get_variant's faf95 there); elsewhere the highest a summed callset reports, gnomad_r4_non_ukb's and each gnomad_r2_1 subset's own. Null when gnomAD reports none, as for AC 0 and singleton variants, and on every row of gnomad_r3, its subsets, and exac, whose list rows carry no FAF.

faf95_max_group.description: Genetic-ancestry group faf95_max comes from (e.g. nfe); null when faf95_max is null or gnomAD names none.

genome_filters.description: QC filters gnomAD applied to the genome call, pipe-joined (e.g. AC0|AS_VQSR; the set varies by dataset, RF on gnomad_r2_1). Empty when the genome call passed QC; null when the genome callset does not carry the variant or gnomAD returned no filter list.

hemizygote_count.description: Hemizygote count (0 off X/Y), from the same source as ac, an, and homozygote_count — under pass_only, the passing callsets of a row without joint data; null when none of them reports one.

hgvsc.description: HGVS coding or transcript notation on transcript_id (e.g. c.137G>T, c.*9G>T); null when gnomAD gives none. Present only when annotations is true; absent (not null) otherwise.

hgvsp.description: HGVS protein notation on transcript_id (e.g. p.Arg46Leu); null when gnomAD gives none, as for a UTR or intronic change. Present only when annotations is true; absent (not null) otherwise.

homozygote_count.description: Homozygote count, from the same source as ac and an — under pass_only, the passing callsets of a row without joint data.

lof.description: LOFTEE's loss-of-function call on transcript_id — HC high-confidence, LC low-confidence, or OS other splice — the value lof_confidence filters on; null when LOFTEE made none. It describes transcript_id, which can be a minor isoform (consequence_transcript other), and is distinct from consequence_class lof, which gnomAD reads from the consequence term.

lof_filter.description: The LOFTEE filter that made the call on transcript_id low-confidence (e.g. END_TRUNC); null when none. Present only when annotations is true; absent (not null) otherwise.

lof_flags.description: LOFTEE's flags on the call on transcript_id, as gnomAD writes them (e.g. PHYLOCSF_WEAK, NAGNAG_SITE) — they can qualify an HC call too; null when none. Present only when annotations is true; absent (not null) otherwise.

qc_status.description: gnomAD's QC verdict, by its browser's rule: pass when at least one callset carrying the variant passed QC (an empty filters column); filtered when none did — gnomAD's browser hides these by default, and AC0 among the filters means no high-quality carrier.

rsids.description: dbSNP rsIDs, pipe-joined; empty when gnomAD lists none. gnomad_search_clinvar's table joins its rsids with semicolons. Present only when annotations is true; absent (not null) otherwise.

transcript_id.description: Ensembl transcript ID (unversioned) the consequence is on; null when gnomAD names none, as for an intergenic variant.

qc_filtered.description: Matching variants that failed gnomAD QC in every callset carrying them (qc_status filtered), counted over every match — not just this page — before pass_only drops them.

spilled.description: True when the matching variants exceeded the inline budget at offset 0, so this call staged every one of them in table_name; the page holds at most limit of them either way.

table_name.description: Canvas table this call staged (gene_variants), holding every matching variant — inspect it with gnomad_dataframe_describe, then query it with gnomad_dataframe_query. Empty when this call staged no table, as on every page past offset 0.

target.description: The resolved target the rows describe: gene symbol or Ensembl gene ID, transcript ID, or region, as normalized for the lookup.

total.description: Total matching variants across every page, not just this one — counted after pass_only drops QC-failed rows when it is set, so it then excludes the qc_filtered rows.

truncated.description: True when matching variants remain past this page; continue with next_offset.

title: gnomad-genetics-mcp-server: list gene variants
